messages:
maya_csm: Quick heads-up 4:50 UTC were seeing intermittent 5xx on EU onboarding + ingest for a slice of tenants (~120). Drafting a customer-facing status + remediation offer. Need quick review before I send.

maya_csm: ```
Subject: Incident update  EU onboarding & ingest interruptions

Hello,

We wanted to let you know about a brief disruption affecting some EU onboarding and indexing/ingest requests earlier today (around 14:4214:58 UTC). A subset of onboarding attempts returned server errors and some index writes were only partially applied.

Short cause: a configuration propagation race in our auth/control plane produced token validation failures for specific onboarding paths.

Action taken: our engineering team deployed a targeted fix and a protective rollback; automated reprocessing ran for most incomplete writes and normal service has been restored.

Impact: approximately 120 tenants experienced failed or partial onboarding/index writes. We do not expect permanent data loss; any remaining items will be replayed with you.

Support & remediation: impacted customers will receive one month of account credit by default. If you are currently in renewal discussions, your AE will contact you to arrange a tailored remediation (timeline extension, credit, or hands-on replays). For SSO/VPC onboarding customers that still see issues, reply to this message or open a ticket and well coordinate a prioritized engineering replay.

Next steps: full RCA will be published within 72 hours and engineering will deploy a permanent fix plus rollout gating to prevent recurrence. Wed also like your feedback  if you experienced impact, please take this short survey so we can improve our onboarding checks: https://redwood.ai/incident-feedback

Thank you for your patience,
Maya  Customer Success, Redwood Inference
```

luca_support: Tone looks good. Add support portal link and a one-liner about how to request the 1:1 enablement session.

harriet_eng: RCA addendum: root cause = propagation race + concurrent control-plane retries causing expired token handoffs for ~3% of EU onboarding requests. Hotfix rolled at 14:50 UTC; safety rollback at 14:56 UTC. Automated backfills finished for ~96% of affected writes; remaining ~4% flagged for manual replay with engineering. Permanent fix (PR + canary + tests) targeted within 72 hours.

harriet_eng: Also confirm we dont expect permanent data loss.

omar_ae: For renewal customers: prefer AE-managed remediation. Please mark impacted renewal accounts in Gainsight and exclude them from the automatic one-month credit until AE outreach completes. Ill take the five accounts Im covering.

nora_billing: Noted. Billing will apply the one-month credit to impacted accounts unless flagged AE-managed. Well produce an export of affected accounts for reconciliation.

luca_support: Recommend adding a short sentence: "If you need immediate assistance, reply to this message and well open a priority ticket and schedule an enablement session."

maya_csm: Added lucas line and survey link. Final Q: timing  I can send the email and post to status at 16:00 UTC. Any objections?

harriet_eng: No objections. Please include: "We will coordinate replay of any remaining items directly with you; we will not bill for any failed onboarding in this window."

maya_csm: Done. Sending at 16:00 and posting to status.redwood.ai. Omar, please flag your renewals in Gainsight and schedule 1:1s.

omar_ae: On it. Ill add notes and set remediation calls for my impacted renewals.

ops-bot: Incident logged INC-20260322-1450  severity: P2  owners: eng-oncall, cs-ops  status: mitigated

maya_csm: Thanks team. Closing thread after send. Please open a follow-up if anything else comes up. :thumbsup:
